input.task: Name the authors quoted in this thread.

provenance: PR #42 R4 (MEDIUM). `_PLURAL_ASK` was a seven-token list, and the reviewer walked around it with ordinary phrasings: `Name the authors...`, `Who are the authors...?`, `Give me the authors...` and the ZH plural form each returned `success, answer 'Marisol Vance'` — one of three authors offered as the answer to a question about the set. This case is the imperative-plus-plural-noun shape (`name the authors`), which carries its plural in the NOUN rather than in a quantifier. `anchor: null` on purpose: with no anchor, rung 1 cannot fire, so the only thing that can refuse this plan is the plural test itself. Watched red first, on the committed regex: `status success, answer 'Marisol Vance'`, verdict PASS.

triage.what_this_grades: one phrasing of the widened plural test, watched red before the widening — the repo's rule for every regex over English (D21): widen on a phrasing a probe actually found, never on synonyms nobody has seen. The remaining ceiling is declared in docs/support-matrix.md D28.
